requiredFutureAcceptance: Retain one pinned custom PBX and pinned Python-only client carrier, network-free clean preflight, two-container internal network, no published ports and all existing resource, isolation, deadline, watchdog and exact-owned-cleanup checks.
Register caller and agent with distinct ephemeral credentials; verify only their expected contacts and retain both configured endpoint/AOR objects.
Add only PJSIP/proof-agent to the initially empty private queue.

Authenticated caller INVITE is answered into private Answer -> Queue(proof-queue,r,,,10) -> Wait(20) -> Hangup. Apply timeoutpriority=app only to proof-queue so the existing seven-second member timeout cannot race the ten-second application queue window.
Host first observes exactly one Up caller in Queue and one Ringing agent with one queued caller.

After the ringing checkpoint, caller sends ACK and correlated BYE to the PBX dialog target; require BYE 200. The caller hangup must cause agent CANCEL/200, INVITE/487 and a matching non-2xx ACK; the agent never answers.
Require all channels to drain, queue C:0/A:1, no callers, no completed member calls, member removal and exact original queue-policy restoration.

Require authenticated unregistration of both identities, zero contacts/channels/callers/members, zero exits, unchanged warmed bridge/inventory and removal of all owned resources and generated credentials.
No retry, RTP/media-quality claim, real phone interoperability, multi-PBX isolation, production operation, Gate A/Gate C acceptance, deployment or redistribution authority.

offlineValidation.description: Unit and mocked client/host/orchestration checks only. No runtime credentials, real sockets, Docker resources or protocol traffic used.

limitations: Caller abandonment uses in-dialog BYE because the PBX has already answered the caller INVITE before entering Queue; it is not an INVITE CANCEL from the caller.
The client agent's CANCEL/200, INVITE/487 and non-2xx ACK handling is a bounded synthetic path, not a general SIP stack or complete conformance test.
The ten-second application queue timeout provides a bounded window; missing the ringing checkpoint or racing the application timeout must fail rather than relax acceptance.
No agent RTP is sent. PCMU SDP validation does not prove media quality or human service.
No caller-abandon runtime attempt has been authorized or executed. Future execution requires separate explicit approval.
